page.overview:
Who is List of prose ponies?

List of prose ponies belongs to My Little Pony. This is a sortable list of ponies which appear in prose stories from chapter books, storybooks, or magazines.

Official names are in bold. These names are mentioned in the stories, on Hasbro's toy line, or stated to be official by the story's crew.

Names that are not in bold are placeholder names which are unofficial and will soon be up for vote. Names in gray are up for vote right now.

Colors are approximate. The table can be sorted by clicking the icon in one of the top row cells.
